versions.changelog:
Initial release of the finance-training-outline skill.

- Generate a 3-day finance training course outline for mid-level finance professionals.
- Supports customizable target audience, duration, key competencies, and training goals.
- Output in structured Markdown format, including course objectives, daily modules, interactive methods, and assessment suggestions.
- Provides course design principles and module examples for easy reference.
- Includes usage instructions and recommended keywords for triggering the skill.
